A. Scope of Work for CAMC for Operation and Maintenance of 50 KLD capacities MBBR based STP 1. The Motors, pumps, spare parts, oil & grease, glands, spanners, maintenance tools tackles etc. Raw mate rials like chemicals etc. consumables necessarily required for day to day operation & maintenance of 50KL D capacity MBBR (Moving Bed Bio Reactor) based STP shall be arranged by bidders. 2. The agency / contractor shall provide 2 Skilled Manpower for smooth operation and Maintena nce works of 50 KLD capacities MBBR based STP. Qualified professionals experience in STP wo rks of minimum 2years Experience shall be deputed on shift basis daily for Monday to Saturda y excluding Sunday & Holidays and also during all working day of the Mint (If any Sunday & Ho lidays). 3. In case of additional labour required for necessary work if any shall have to be arrange by firm. 4. Preparation & Dosing Chemical Solutions of required concentration and quantity. 5. General cleaning and house-keeping ( Cleaning of drain, channel, MS grating in STP etc.to ensure the clea nliness in and around water works area including, jungle and general cleaning.) 6. Replacing the Pressure sand Filter Media and Replacing the Activated carbon filter Media by firm Scope. 7. 5. Clean / Preventive / maintain the air filters on Air Blowers regularly. Change air Filters periodically/ whe never required. 8. Operation of all electrical & mechanical machinery including electrical panels. 9. Clean / Preventive / minor the air filters on Air Blowers regularly. Change ate air Filters periodically. 10. Preventive/minor maintenance of pumps, blowers, Motors and Other equipment’s. 11. All chamber, all screen bars (manual & auto) and all tank cleaning 12. Bidder has to follow plant safety rules, security rules, and labour contract Act etc.as applicable and amen ded time to time. 13. Bidders have to ensure treatment compliance as per TSPCB/CPCB discharge norms by smooth operation of all wastewater treatment facilities such as STP. 14. Bidder /contractor has to operate all kinds of pumps, motors, compressor, filtration unit and other proces s equipment including maintain them in good working condition installed in the STP. 15. Bidder/ contractor has to operate filtration plant for uninterrupted supply of treated water for gardening I GMH Plant and Township, including back wash of filtration plant. 16. Operator has to write & maintain the plant operation & maintenance of logbook on daily basis in shifts if required. 17. Operation of filtration plant for ensuring smooth supply of treated water for irrigation/gardening purpose. 18. STP operators have to do all works and given report day to day in charge time to time. 19. The cost of consumables & spares will be borne by the agency only, Consumables materials like test lam p, bolts, dusters, liveries etc required for operation & maintenance, 20. PPE for safety of workmen engaged shall have to be provided by Bidder/contractor. 21. Maintain necessary records, return, manifestation system, log book or other statutory records as directed by Regulatory body for compliance of Rules & Regulation relating to conservation & protection of Environm ent. 22. Periodical visit on monthly basis by the Environmental Engineer. 23. The CAMC service contract shall be for a period of 12 (Twelve) Months

B. General Conditions 1. Bidder /contractor taken STP Inlet and Outlet water samples from Mint and carry out the analysis report f or Standard parameters as per the TSPCB CFO rules i.e. pH, Total Suspended Solids -TSS, Dissolved Solids, Oil & Grease, Chlorides, Sulphates, Bio Chemical Oxygen Demand- BOD & Chemical Oxygen Demand- COD 2. Analysis report has to be submitted monthly once. 3. Payment shall be made on monthly basis. 4. It is strongly advised for prospective bidders to visit the site of work to get a thorough understanding of th e scope of work involved. No request for clarification on tender scope shall be entertained after opening of bids. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I. Eligibility Criteria: The bidder firm should meet following eligibility criteria to qualify: (a) For MSE/Start-up firm: The bidder must have capability to provide the relevant services. (b) For other firm - Experience and past performance: The bidder should have experience of having succes sfully supplied relevant services of at least ₹ 3.5 Lakhs in any one of the last five years ending on 31.03.20 26. (C) The bidder should submit signed & stamped copy of bid document as a token of acceptance of scope of work and all other terms & condition of the tender. II. Payment Terms: Payment shall be made on monthly basis and within 30 days after submission of bills a nd approval by competent authority of IGMH. III. Bidders who are not registered as services as major category in Udyam certificate should submit EMD a mount. Otherwise their bid will be rejected as this tender comes under category of Services .
